issues.quote: I never look at clocks when I am playing with Casimir. It is the only way I have ever won.
issues.fact: O2 says only that she did not look at the clock when he went out to fetch his cigars. It gives no general habit of not looking at clocks during play.
issues.misreading: A solver could take this as a general statement that she never checked the time during the whole piquet game or the piano playing, which would make her time estimates less reliable than the sheet supports. It could also suggest she was not tracking time at all.

issues.quote: The doctor and I played piquet in the salon. Casimir plays badly, and he cheats only when he is losing
issues.fact: The sheet says "the doctor" and never names him. The transcript later introduces Casimir Vauthier as a family friend, but never explicitly states that the doctor is Casimir.
issues.misreading: A careful solver could hesitate over whether the doctor and Casimir are the same man, since the link is only implied. That matters because every 'he' in the piquet and cigar passage depends on it.
